projects.title: When the Past meets the Present
projects.brief: A reinterpretation of an archetypical structure, readapted to site, program, and material conditions.
projects.description: Creating enduring, human-centered spaces where functional clarity meets poetic design.

projects.title: Riverside Quarters
projects.brief: Modular timber dwelling integrated seamlessly into riparian landscape topography.
projects.description: Riverside Quarters is an exploration into low-impact timber housing overlooking riverbanks. The volume is split into distinct pavilions connected by elevated timber decks.

gallery.caption: Riverside Quarters - East Elevation Landscape View
Interior Living Space with River Panorama

projects.title: Coastal Cliff House
projects.brief: Cantilevered exposed concrete volumes interacting with coastal tides and wind patterns.
projects.description: Perched on a seaside precipice, this residential study combines rough-cast board-formed concrete and expansive glazing to channel coastal winds and frame uninterrupted sea horizons.

gallery.caption: Cantilevered Terrace and Sea Horizon Framing
